changes.description: Personal Library: upload, keep, and download your own files. They stay private and never mix with community knowledge.
Projects: each project has its own files and one ongoing chat. Ask, draft, and generate from those files.
The assistant can see your full library and still tell selected project files apart—so “how many documents do I have?” is accurate.
Download generated drafts (PDF or markdown) from a project reply. A circular loader shows while the file is ready.
Project replies use the same toolbar as community chat: copy, speak, thumbs, reply, and regenerate (replaces that answer and everything after it).
Closed-app Web Push alerts when VAPID is configured; enable from the bell footer.
Admin desk: publish updates, Drive assets, meeting links, and knowledge drafts from the web (same pipelines as WhatsApp/Telegram).
Meetings hub loads live community meetings; admins can add sessions in one tap.

title: Live Meetings Hub & Resilient Assistant Experience

changes.description: Live Meetings & Sessions Hub: Direct access to cohort syncs, mentor office hours, and masterclasses across Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom.
In-App Feature Suggestions: Submit tool improvements with instant escalation to community coordinators via Telegram & WhatsApp bots.
Smooth Modal & Dropdown Animations: Fluid ease-out transitions on opening and closing all dialogs, popovers, and drawers.
Sanitized Error Shield: Replaced technical backend exception details with clean, reassuring, user-friendly guidance.
Compact Modern Controls: Unified input and button heights, edge-aligned header actions, and visible Install App header pill.
Animated Skeleton Loading: Instant visual feedback and shimmer placeholders during session discovery and resource lookups.
Full ChatGPT aesthetic overhaul with dark/light themes, collapsible sidebar, and conversation history.
Clickable Quick Commands & Slash Menu: Auto-populate /ask, /share, /feature, /help directly into your composer.
Refined notification dropdown anchored directly to header with zero scrollbar clutter.
Guaranteed Smart Auto-Scroll: Sticks to bottom during live bot typing, streaming, and input focus.
Unified Notification & Changelog Dropdown: In-app release notes and community announcements from the API.
Hands-free voice recognition with live audio visualizer and speech-to-text querying.
Progressive Web App support: Install as standalone mobile or desktop app with offline capability.
Rich interactive meeting cards with 1-click launch for Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Google Meet.
Direct Drive asset registration via /asset and WhatsApp/Telegram export ingestion via /import.
Dual-layer permission validation ensuring community isolation.
Resolved citation revalidation timeouts on complex technical queries.
